visual_grammar.label: Option 1 — 35mm Historical Live-Action Docudrama (Clear-Air V4.1)
visual_grammar.visual_style_lock: Shot on 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T film, historical battle cinema docudrama, Ridley Scott Kingdom of Heaven aesthetic, practical period-accurate 10th-11th century Dai Viet lamellar armor and Song Dynasty iron laminar armor, authentic wet mud, crisp optical clarity, deep-focus 35mm anamorphic depth, dramatic directional sunlight or warm Caravaggio torchlight chiaroscuro, rich tactile armor and terrain detail, natural film grain, zero CGI plasticity, zero text in frame.
visual_grammar.negative_constraints: NO 2D cartoon, NO vector illustration, NO woodblock print, NO modern glasses, NO wristwatches, NO neon, NO glowing magic, NO samurai katana, NO European plate armor, NO AI gibberish text, NO signage, NO banners with text, NO cherry blossoms, NO plastic skin

tier_descriptions.TIER_1_WARROOM_MAP: 3D topographical tactical warroom diorama (Kings and Generals / Fern), deep slate-earth topography, torchlit contours, military arrows and troop formations.
tier_descriptions.TIER_2_TACTICAL_CUTAWAY: 3D cross-section and mechanical military cutaway (submerged ironwood stakes, trebuchet/crossbow/fireship diagrams, layered defense geometry).
tier_descriptions.TIER_3_EPIC_BATTLE_PAINTING: Dramatic heroic historical cinema still with crisp optical clarity, deep-focus 35mm anamorphic depth, dramatic directional sunlight or warm Caravaggio torchlight chiaroscuro, rich tactile armor and terrain detail, and crimson banners.

cinematic_diversity_rule_v4_1.clear_air_style_lock: crisp optical clarity, deep-focus 35mm anamorphic depth, dramatic directional sunlight or warm Caravaggio torchlight chiaroscuro, rich tactile armor and terrain detail
cinematic_diversity_rule_v4_1.dust_smoke_cloud_allowed_only_on: genuine cannon or fire-weapon beats (frame-edge translucent torch ember wisp only, never opaque fog white-out)
